metadata.summary: Built and merged xtrax.telemetry: an append-only, flock'd run ledger capturing git provenance + content-addressed jaxpr/StableHLO, enforced fail-closed at Engine.fit/eval, at claim time, and by a CI gate. Merged to main as 35c5100 (PR #108, 38 files/+5,497) after PR #107 landed first. NOTE: reviewed via /code-review (3 real bugs found and fixed) plus full CI — a praxia-auditor was NOT dispatched.

failed_attempts.description: Declared an optional `provenance = ["cisternal>=..."]` extra in pyproject.toml so xtrax.telemetry could use cisternal.provenance for durable per-run git refs.
failed_attempts.outcome: uv could not resolve the project AT ALL, for every user, including those never requesting the extra. Error: 'no version of fastmcp==4.0.0a2' / 'requirements are unsatisfiable'.
failed_attempts.reason_failed: cisternal hard-pins fastmcp==4.0.0a2, an exact PRE-RELEASE, as a runtime dependency, and uv resolves EVERY extra when building the lock. An optional extra that breaks the default install is not optional. cisternal.provenance itself is pure stdlib, so the blocker is packaging, not architecture.

failed_attempts.description: Ran a plain `git rebase origin/main` on the telemetry branch after PR #107 was squash-merged.
failed_attempts.outcome: Git began replaying all 39 commits onto a main that already contained 38 of them (squashed), and hit a content conflict on commit 1/39 in pyproject.toml and tests/audit/test_tombstone_ledger.py. Aborted.
failed_attempts.reason_failed: PR #107 was SQUASH-merged, so its constituent commits (b11a768, 801a980) never became ancestors of main even though their content is on main. A plain rebase therefore tries to re-apply already-applied patches. Correct form is `git rebase --onto origin/main <shared-base> HEAD`, replaying only the genuinely-new commits — that succeeded with ZERO conflicts.

open_questions: Should a praxia-auditor be dispatched retroactively over the merged telemetry code? Review was /code-review + CI only; per standing preference an auditor is normally run for substance on non-trivial implementations before merge.

Is XTRAX_CAPTURE_IR=full+optimized worth making the default? Measurement showed optimized HLO costs only ~8KB gzipped, contradicting the initial assumption that it was too large — but it is device-specific.
